prose: AI inference startup Fal raised $1.3 billion led by Bessemer at a $16 billion valuation, up from $8 billion in April, per Bloomberg; a source says it hit $800 million in annualized revenue this year. Fal hosts image, video and audio models for creators and developers, doubling its valuation in about six months.
highlights: Fal raises $1.3B led by Bessemer at $16B, doubling its April valuation
Source says $800M annualized revenue this year, per Bloomberg
Hosts image, video and audio models for creators and developers
basis: Error cache: Bloomberg paywall/bot-block. Written from the Techmeme headline and lede.
